cost: Sentence: O(F) direct checks plus sum over frames of O(U*D*R) unsaid child scans/membership, lexical lookup and text bytes; O(R) temporary used indices plus output. Spread add: O(F(log G+log C)) map work and copied strings; O(K) retained accepted occurrences. counts scans class-map cardinalities; hits scans classes and losing occurrences with repeated detail formatting. No corpus/parser/teacher/persistence cost is measured.
description: Domain X is tagged Sentence(Tree,ordered frames,aligned anchors), or finite Spread action trace starting at default state. Sentence requires valid cached Tree child indices and in-range predicate anchors, with anchors[i] belonging to frames[i]. For frame i, row=i+1; append copula-no-who iff Fact Is/IsA or non-Bare verb be lacks agent, time-in-where iff time_word(place.id,place.named), and who-is-what iff equal nonempty ASCII-case-insensitive agent/patient IDs survive reflexive and both-bare exclusions. Then each unsaid slot uses its aligned predicate's first unused qualifying child; Agent accepts passive OblAgent or nonpassive Nsubj, Patient NsubjPass or non-time Obj, Recipient Iobj; other slots abstain. Spread appends only VerbNet/nonempty-signature frames to key (verb,signature), class, ordered (id,i+1) occurrences. counts=(number of keys,number of keys with >1 class). Winner per key is lexicographically smallest class among maximal occurrence counts; hits emits every losing occurrence in key/class order and within-class insertion order.

inverse: B(tag,y) retains all well-formed trees, ordered frames, aligned anchors and sentence-hit traces satisfying the predicates, or all initial-default Spread add histories and class occurrence maps yielding the selected counts/hits observation. Sentence absence can arise from valid roles, reflexive/bare exclusions, missing anchors, used children or absent matching dependents; retain these distinct causes. Spread counts lose proportions and IDs; losing hits omit winner occurrence IDs and ignored frames. Occurrence duplicates and class insertion order remain latent state. Neither diagnostic hits nor their absence reconstruct actual referents or semantic truth.
limitations: Finite supplied-input checks, not full parser/corpus/teacher/DB or live course evidence.
Partial syntax leaves macro bodies opaque; no semantic AST or universal proof.
Environment optional rules and malformed anchor/cache states remain explicit unexecuted boundaries.
state: Sentence hits preserve 1-based frame row association; anchors and token indices stay zero-based and are never substituted for frame row numbers. Missing anchor/predicate suppresses only unsaid-own. Any anchored-role use excludes that token for all unsaid slots; reflexives and both-bare unresolved identities exclude who-is-what. Multiple hits per row and repeated unsaid slots are possible. Spread counts occurrences, including repeated add calls/IDs; no deduplication or absolute majority is required. Single-class groups have no losers, ties choose smaller class and different verb/signature keys never share a winner.
